_comment: The city (#333, #220, #338, part of #331): a European city of perimeter blocks beside the road. at: metres out from the start along the road; side: metres from the road's middle to the city's near edge (negative: the other side). size (metres, square), blocks (a side), street_width (kerb to kerb, the ring at the edge), avenue_width (the streets between blocks, round the square), street_jitter (how far, in metres, each street line may sit off a regular grid), pavement (width), passage_width and gateway_height (the arched way through each street front into its courtyard, metres; never higher than under the first floor), building_depth (a street front gives some up, down to 8, where the block is short), floors_edge and floors_middle (storeys at the edge and toward the middle), style (danish for now; see #335). asphalt: the streets' colour [r, g, b]. kerb_width and tile_size (metres): the kerb stones round each pavement and its paving slabs. crossing_width and crossing_setback: zebra crossings this long, this far back from each junction, in bars zebra_stripe wide. lamp_spacing and lamp_inset: street lamps on both sides, half a step out of line across the street, this far in from the kerb; tree_spacing, tree_inset, tree_street_width: trees in grates along streets at least this wide; tree_height, tree_crown and tree_trunk (metres). door_clear: no lamp or tree within this many metres of a front door; spot_nudge: how far a lamp or tree may move along the kerb to keep a door, gateway or crossing clear before it is left out. pad_blend: metres over which the levelled city eases back into the land. builds_per_frame: buildings put up each frame while the city loads. guards (server): how many stand behind street windows on upper floors (window_posts), on flat roofs (roof_posts), on pavement corners (corner_posts), and walk round blocks (patrols); a wiped-out garrison comes back after refill_seconds with no player within refill_distance metres.
